title: CIA-created UFO news outlet appearing around the time of the Lazar film
summary: Jeremy Corbell tells of CIA-created UFO news outlet appearing around the time of the Lazar film, about c. 2018 at Online; operated from overseas, and reports it citing named sources. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: That is a CIA stood up media source.

plain: A filmmaker and journalist, Jeremy Corbell, says that an online UFO news outlet that appeared around 2018, about when his film on Bob Lazar (a man who says he worked on alien craft) came out, was set up by the CIA and run from overseas. If true, it would mean the agency was shaping UFO news from the inside.
